Ever wondered what a ride built entirely around the road, the people, and the moment would feel like? I did too.

 

Cigala Cycling Tours grew out of years of coaching riders of every level — and the realization that people don't just want to ride, they want to experience. So I built tours around exactly that: hand-picked roads, small groups, no crowds, no shortcuts.

Every trip is guided by a team of former pros who know these roads because they've ridden them for years, not read them off a script. Good food, real local stops, and the kind of ride you actually remember.

More than a decade in, that idea hasn't changed.

We'd love to welcome you on the road.

- Matteo Cigala, Tours Director -

Legendary Climbs

Ride Europe's most iconic roads and mountain passes.

Local Knowledge

Discover cafes, viewpoints and roads most visitors never find.

Meet Our Tours Director

Ride With Matteo Cigala

Matteo Cigala is a former Gran Fondo European Champion, Vice Gran Fondo World Champion and National Gravel Champion. Founder & Tours Director of Cigala Cycling Tours & Founders & Head Coach at Cigala Cycling Coaching.

Every tour is carefully designed by Matteo and let either by him or a member of the team — not a seasonal tour guide — so you're riding with people who know these roads from racing on them and organising tours for over a decade.

Learn More About Matteo & The Team →

Read what our guests from the last 10 years have to say

The Ultimate Bike Experience

★★★★★

This was my first cycling trip, and I was depending on Cigala Tours to make it a good one. They did not disappoint. Matteo, Merine and company were fantastic, putting together a great itinerary (rides, lunches and dinners, and other activities), and making sure that everyone had a wonderful time. The accommodations were nice, and all of the chosen restaurants were excellent. And if you haven’t been to Lake Garda, you have to go; it’s beautiful.

I had so much fun, and can’t wait until my next trip with Cigala Tours. Thank you Matteo and Merine for being tremendous hosts. I’ll see you again soon.

Steve, Canada ★★★★★

As an added bonus, Matteo captures the action with amazing photos. Can’t wait to take another tour with Cigala.

The riding was spectacular, the scenery was out of this world, the food was amazing and everything ran so smoothly that all we had to do was enjoy ourselves. Matteo knows these roads like the back of his hand and somehow found the perfect balance of challenging climbs, unforgettable descents and coffee stops.
